'''Bonadan''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] and the primary world in the [[Bonadan system/Legends|Bonadan system]] at the end of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], boasting ten large [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]]. The densely populated planet housed many exotic [[Species/Legends|species]] from around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Bonadanians found off-world were either from wealthy corporate families or those that had escaped the life of corporate servitude.

==Geography==
[[File:BonadanSurface.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Scarred surface of Bonadan]]
Bonadan's yellow, parched surface was heavily eroded, and its topsoil had been destroyed due to constant drilling and construction. The once-beautiful landscape was scorched and barren from years of strip-mining, pollution, and mismanagement. The remaining surface was covered with factories, refineries, docks, and shipbuilding facilities in ten [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]], the largest being [[Spaceport Southeast II]].

A massive weather-control station lay in the mountains to the north of the main cities; it was used to generate [[sweeper storm]]s that cleaned the polluted air. Despite this, foul-smelling rain and pollution was widespread. Weapons were banned on Bonadan, and being caught by one of the omnipresent [[weapon detector]]s was grounds for immediate arrest. Newcomers were thoroughly scanned before landing.

From space, Bonadan was a yellow sphere covered with rust-red strips. It looked barren and parched, for whatever plant life not killed deliberately died due to careless mining operations, abundant pollutants, and simple neglect. The [[tortapo]] was some of the last surviving fauna on the planet.

==History==
An emerging society<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> as of [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the Bonadan people financed efforts to explore [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by selling small arms and [[Bonadan alloy heavy suit|armor]]. When producing this armor, the Bonadan preferred to use heavier materials so the wearer would be better protected.<ref name="KOTOR" /> Despite their exports, weapons were illegal on the planet, though their armor exports were considered very high quality.<ref name="Campaign">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

[[File:Bonadan_eaw.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Bonadan during the Galactic Civil War]]

In the early years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had set up a supply commerce on Bonadan consisting of several cargo containers being readied for shipment by [[CT-11 space tug]]s. Two [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]], ''[[Deddite]]'' and ''[[Banthar]]'', were to pick up the cargo and deliver them to the Imperial fleet. However, two [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] [[Raid above Bonadan|arrived and destroyed]] the containers and the two freighters before the Imperial [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Enforcer (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Enforcer'']] could arrive.<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref>

Around the same time, the planet's [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] had communication with [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Dol Donar II]], and offered him a case of [[Wine/Legends|wine]] with a note, but the latter's premature death prevented its opening.<ref name="Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref>

Despite a claim of neutrality during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], representatives of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] were bought off by the [[Yuuzhan Vong|alien invaders]].<ref name="EOTV">"[[Emissary of the Void]]"</ref>

The [[Bonadan Cough]] was a contagious virus that originated from Bonadan and caused the sufferer to have a hoarse cough and deep fatigue.<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
